ev.q: Necromunda: Hired Gun is a first-person shooter game
It is set in the Warhammer 40,000 universe
takes place on the mechanized planet of Necromunda
The game has platforming sections scattered throughout the game
The game features stealth mechanics where the player can sneak past enemies
The game is linear, with stages that can be played through normally
where the player works for various factions in the planet's criminal underworld
The player can execute an enemy using a melee finisher
The player can choose multiple ranged weapons, with upgrades available for them
This finicky setup made it harder to pull off in the heat of combat
The player has a combat dog, which can be used to spot and attack enemies
